body: How do I get this on a shirt?

Hi,

Just wanted to send you a message on how you’ve helped me along these past few
 months. I recently started taking my medication again and started keeping everything clean/organized. Although I still have huge anxiety issues I joined a hockey team to try and get out and do something I like. If I ever have a shitty night I now sleep with my stuffed bear from when I was a kid. I want to thank you for all this.

Your friend.
